verdict.rationale: The evidence describes autonomous AI agents for screening, transaction monitoring and level-1 alert remediation. It also shows llms.txt and OpenAPI docs that agents could consume. None of it documents a natural-language command interface for users to operate the product. The agentic workflows are adjacent automation, and the agent-readable docs are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
